info.text:
The bondsman keeps your $2,000 even when you show up.
On $20,000 bail, agents often charge a nonrefundable 10% fee: $2,000.
The insurer backing the bond typically takes about 10% of the fee; the agent keeps most of the rest, but can owe the full $20,000 if you skip court.
In the 75 largest US counties, surety bonds went from 24% of felony releases (1990-94) to 42% (2002-04).
Sources: Bureau of Justice Statistics (2007 report); California Department of Insurance; PolitiFact (2018). Rules vary by state.
News and education, not financial advice.
